LAND ACQUISITION ACT (Chapter 460) Notice under Section 7
My No. WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/03. Land Min’s Ref. No. : 4/3/10/2012/LRB-15.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to develop Katu Ela from Rattanapitiya to Bellanwila Marshy land under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project.
